title: Kamishiro Rui — Sound Sleep〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of our Christmas show performances were a smash hit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With that now behind us, we should start thinking of our next show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. The next show for the contest is important, but if we're to do it in parallel with our regular shows, we have to get a head start.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, then our meeting today can be about strategizing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. But I also have an announcement to make first.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: An announcement?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. We've taken part in two rounds of this contest, spanning the period from Halloween until Christmas...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I've been keeping a close eye on our rivals throughout this time too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, how...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good job, Rui!
So you've got some intel for us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I do. After seeing other contestants' performances, I've arrived upon what our two greatest strengths are.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh! Oh! And...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The first one is the novelty Wonderlands×Showtime brings.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Novelty?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Have you seen what kinds of shows the other troupes in the park are doing?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, some of them... The ones at the Hero Stage have been about superheroes who defend the park against villains by challenging them to games and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: At the Mascot Stage, they've been doing stories about Phenny!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly, so consider this. Have you ever seen a show that wasn't about superheroes at the Hero Stage?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Or a show that didn't feature mascots, like Phenny, at the Mascot Stage?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, of course not.
They have to stick with their themes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Most of the other Phoenix Wonderland troupes always do shows revolving around their respective themes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As a result, the scope of their performances predictably becomes limited.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
On the other hand, we're the newcomers.
And we're not bound to any specific theme.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ah, I see. No one expects us to do only certain shows, so we can switch between different genres as we like, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, precisely! You see how this plays to our advantage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Our second greatest strength is individuality as our troupe is full of distinctive personalities.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
In other words...
We're a bunch of weirdos.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait... Why are you staring at me?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No reason...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. The other troupes have a singular, star performer, such as Sakurako from Phoenix Stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And naturally, their shows are all designed to have their respective stars be in the limelight.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But theatrical shows are supposed to focus on the lead actor or actress, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, of course. But in the case of our rivals, they always cast the same players as their leads.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On top of that, those roles are often very similar, or part of a series of shows where the leads are always playing the same characters.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In other words, there's no variety.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait... But don't we always have the same cast for every show?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but our roles are much more diverse.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa sometimes plays two or even three different parts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And each role is quite different from the other.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's also not forget that we had two leads in our Christmas show with Tsukasa and Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can easily see you in a lead role too, Emu, with your rich expressions and talent for acrobatics.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I believe any one of us from Wonderlands×Showtime has the potential to be a brilliant lead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. Us being such a motley crew does give us a sort of unique advantage.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We have the freedom to switch things up so that our plays never become stale, and we can tackle any genre.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! The Wonder Stage can be a window into unlimited fantastic worlds for everyone to enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And that's precisely what we set out to do when we decided to become Wonderlands×Showtime...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right. Staying true to that will definitely give us an edge in the contest too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. It's important to have a goal to stick to...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, that was a rather long preamble to my vision for our next show. I would like it to be based on these two strengths: novelty and personality.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I agree.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
Hehehe. I'm so excited about this♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright! Then let's come up with a story for our new show that takes our strengths into account!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Let's make our next show one for the ages. Together.
